title: Set integrals over the shrunken cubes Q_δ converge to the integral over Q₁ as δ ↓ 0
statement: Let k ∈ ℕ, Euclid k = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) with Lebesgue measure (volume), Q₁ := {y : 0 < y_i < 1 for all i} and, for δ ∈ ℝ, Q_δ := {z : δ < z_i < 1 − δ for all i}. If f : Euclid k → ℝ is integrable on Q₁, then ∫_{Q_δ} f → ∫_{Q₁} f as δ → 0⁺ (i.e. along the filter 𝓝[>] 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (f : Euclid k → ℝ), IntegrableOn f {y : Euclid k | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => ∫ y in {z : Euclid k | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, f y) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ y in {y : Euclid k | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, f y))
